_comment: v1.16.6 - Bellum Iugurthinum 1, 4, 5, 6, 8: the Iugurtha begins. sall.2 prints chapter numbers only; sections come from Perseus phi0631.phi002 perseus-lat3 through mark_sections (batch/marks1166.json). The CTS API answers 500 for 4 and 5 and overruns into the next chapter for 6 and 8, so every section file was built with the new tools/xml_sections.js from the GitHub XML. The page modernises spelling throughout (maxime, cuius, existimo); 4.4 prints 'adeptus sum' where Perseus has 'sim' (kept, explained).
